interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections or mid-block to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to provide space for a center turn lane or bike lanes, which naturally slows traffic.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation or Narrowing
interventions.description: Narrow the parking lot entrance to reduce the conflict zone and slow entering/exiting vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture
interventions.description: Add street trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Install Street Trees or Planters
interventions.description: Adding vegetation would provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Driveway Markings
interventions.description: Using high-visibility pavement markings or a continuous sidewalk material across the driveway would alert drivers to the pedestrian priority zone.

interventions.title: Install Raised Sidewalk and Curb
interventions.description: Construct a dedicated, raised sidewalk with a curb to provide physical separation and protection for pedestrians from the roadway.

interventions.title: Bollards or Planters
interventions.description: Install bollards or permanent planters along the new curb line to prevent vehicles from parking on or encroaching into the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Defined Parking Stalls
interventions.description: Clearly mark and organize parking areas to ensure they do not overlap with pedestrian paths of travel.

interventions.title: Mid-block crossing with refuge island
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a central refuge island to provide a safe crossing point and break up the long crossing distance.

interventions.title: Street trees and landscaping
interventions.description: Add more street trees, especially on the left side, to provide a vertical buffer and psychologically narrow the street to slow traffic.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Bypass
interventions.description: Provide a safe, ADA-compliant temporary pedestrian path around the construction zone using barriers to separate people from traffic.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk across the driveway area with consistent paving materials and markings to clearly define pedestrian priority.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming measures to maintain lower vehicle speeds along this straight stretch.

interventions.title: Raised Sidewalk and Curbing
interventions.description: Install a raised curb to physically separate the pedestrian walkway from the travel and parking lanes.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Define the vehicle access point more clearly with bollards or a narrowed curb cut to reduce the conflict area.

interventions.title: Clear Path Maintenance
interventions.description: Ensure a minimum clear width is maintained by regulating the placement of commercial displays on the walkway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing or Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes or narrow them to include bike lanes, which slows traffic and provides a larger buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or large planters to create a vertical buffer between pedestrians and the roadway, improving comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Refuge
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Maintenance
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk or create local bump-outs around existing trees to ensure a consistent, ADA-compliant clear walking path.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crosswalk with high-visibility paint to provide a designated safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-scale lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting specifically designed to illuminate the sidewalk and crossing areas to improve safety during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and pedestrian warning signs to formalize crossing points.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to potential crossing points to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Street Tree Planting
interventions.description: Plant trees in the existing pits to provide shade and a vertical buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Furniture Zone Implementation
interventions.description: Utilize the wide sidewalk to install benches, bike racks, or planters to create a protective buffer from the roadway.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to facilitate safe crossing for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Clearance of Obstructions
interventions.description: Ensure the pedestrian clear zone is maintained by removing large containers or dumpsters from the sidewalk area.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Warning Signage
interventions.description: Install signage or auditory/visual warnings at the garage exit to alert pedestrians of exiting vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Fill and pave the missing sidewalk section to provide a continuous, level walking surface.

interventions.title: Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Relocate portable toilets and construction equipment to the parking lane or a designated staging area off the main walkway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Replace standard parallel line markings with continental or ladder patterns to increase visibility to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to provide a safe crossing point on this long block.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Convert the existing painted bike lane into a physically protected lane to separate cyclists from both moving traffic and the door zone of parked cars.
